reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "The previously deprecated `metallb-bgp` flags `bgp-config-path`, `bgp-announce-lb-ip` and `bgp-announce-pod-cidr` have been removed", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: setting-ignored

consequence.statement: The metallb-bgp flags bgp-config-path, bgp-announce-lb-ip and bgp-announce-pod-cidr have been removed. Configurations that still rely on them no longer get metallb-based BGP advertisements, because users are now required to use the Cilium BGP control plane.
consequence.remediation: Before upgrading, move BGP advertisements to the Cilium BGP control plane and remove the metallb-bgp flags.

proposed.statement: Cilium 1.17.0 removes the deprecated metallb-bgp flags bgp-config-path, bgp-announce-lb-ip and bgp-announce-pod-cidr; BGP advertisements must now use the Cilium BGP control plane.
